criteria.reason: Copy Last and Done always render, but Next is conditional and disappears when the keypad is on reps.
Done uses flex sizing alongside the other actions, so it is narrower than its former full-width layout.
The action buttons’ padding and text height provide at least a 44px touch target.
Copy Last uses the previous set’s value for the active field and sends it through onChange.
Next switches the keypad state to reps, but NumericKeypad’s local display is not updated when its value prop changes.
The new action styling uses design tokens, but Done retains a hard-coded white text color.
The actions use a flexible row layout that can fit within the keypad sheet on mobile.
The button labels contain no exclamation marks or hype.
The harness reports all server and client tests passing.
A new test verifies that Copy Last sends the previous value to onChange.
